description: Defines the interface and data structures for socket connection jobs within the Chromium networking stack, including parameters, callback mechanisms, and the ConnectJob class with its delegate.

classes.name: CommonConnectJobParams
classes.description: Holds immutable socket parameters shared across ConnectJob types, including pointers to factories, resolvers, and configuration settings.

classes.name: ConnectJob
classes.description: Abstract interface for establishing socket connections, managing connection states, timing, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: ConnectJob::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about connection completion and proxy authentication challenges.

methods.name: ConnectJob::Connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, returning status codes indicating success, pending, or error.

methods.name: ConnectJob::PassSocket
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the connected socket to the caller.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ChangePriority
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of the connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the connection process.

methods.name: ConnectJob::HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates whether a TCP connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Provides a list of failed connection attempts.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves error info from host resolution attempts.

methods.name: ConnectJob::IsSSLError
methods.description: Indicates if the last failure was SSL-related.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Returns SSL client auth request info if applicable.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Provides routing info for the connection.

methods.name: ConnectJob::set_done_closure
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked upon deletion of the ConnectJob.
